A compact record bay sits beside the original seal and closed real gate.
One human-sized bay exactly fits the140-wide report ledge; eaves overhang, posts do not.
Broad gabled report archive anchored to the actual east return court.
Open rear gallery locates the cross-cover group without adding a platform or projectile cover.
The narrow register court receives one full-height storage bay rather than a floating wide house.
A broad restrained hall backs the original defense and nearby exit; no new terminal walk.
The two original ledgers meet at the unchanged comparison point.

vertical22.scope: Fresh role composition and safe finite-entry runtime candidate. Existing five objectives, two gates, action limit3, finite responses7 + defence2 and XP ceiling preserved. Combat, art, App/browser and normal-resource completion remain separately reviewed.
deviations: D is the west turning shoulder (280,2750); its west ascent remains optional.
G and H share the highest 970-unit court at y1200. The original radius460 fits around G, and H has 245 units of clear floor beyond the exit.
Long approach flats are shortened; the wider B/E wings remain usable without making their far ends mandatory.

groups.purpose: 봉인 앞 수비병과 서쪽 서리·궁귀 묶음. 봉인 작업 공간과 초기 후열을 압박한다.
판문 뒤 경사 수비병, 계단 입구의 장부귀와 궁귀가 첫 반응 진입을 엄호한다.
사건 보고를 지키는 밀집 두 명과 판문 너머 사격수. 보고 작업점에서 위쪽 갤러리에 각도가 열린다.
먼 서쪽 끝을 청소시키지 않는 가까운 회랑 엄호조. 필수 동쪽 경사와 선택 서쪽 회귀 양쪽에서 접근할 수 있다.
호적각 아래 계단의 서로 다른 높이와 사선. 보고 반응의 위쪽을 엄호하지만 다른 층의 세 행동을 선점하지 않는다.
호적 작업점의 두 명과 동쪽 돌아오르는 입구의 두 명. 서측 선택 경로에서 후방 각도를 잡을 수 있다.
대조대의 근접 앞줄과 출구 방향 후열. 방어 종료 뒤 전원 청소나 추가 전투를 요구하지 않는다.

vertical22Art.style: Korean administrative terraces: cut granite blocks, subdued gable and hip tile roofs, horizontal bound folios, square timber recesses. Upper-left key light, broad rear support shadows.
vertical22Art.collisionPolicy: Only the main archive sampled tiled roof is oneWay; house interiors and ground stay open. Foreground paint clips to the geometry source. Separate geometry revision adds a west-route pause court; objectives, east required path and gates remain unchanged.
vertical22Art.rearPolicy: One receding rock shoulder joins verified lower supports. Overlong timber frames removed; existing houses retain shallow plinths. No scenic collision or new walk rim.
